title: Independently replay four chart-268 and chart-635 diagnostics
body:
## Mathematical result

Independent complete arithmetic and literal replays cover the two original #8006 diagnostics and two fresh round controls. Each has rank zero in the chart-2 to chart-525 block where the original operator requires rank one. Invertible source and output basis changes within their respective charts cannot repair that block.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. Round 10’s relevant scoped priors are #8008, #8009 and #8011.

## Validation

Both isolated verify.py and fresh_verify.py, manifests, complete signed invoices and source corruption controls passed. The repaired 451 arithmetic on both recent price profiles does not overcome their exact operator errors.

## Open next questions

A changed physical operator must pass the original and adjoint matrices and the unresolved stock, owned erasure, precision and outer application premises.
